description: Story 21.6 — super-admin platform campaigns (Bref /v1/campaigns, 20.13 route K1) and the platform WhatsApp number (inbox, templates, media). SUPER_ADMIN JWT only (/api/v1/admin/**); owners get 403. Keevo envelope: success {data}; error {error (French), code, domainCode, details?}. Show statusLabel / channelLabel / actionLabel, never the codes; ids are handles (tenantIds in the segment are for the edit form, show company names). Change this file only with both sides.

channels.PUSH: Notification (kept in the app inbox, type PLATFORM_CAMPAIGN)
channels.WHATSAPP: WhatsApp (approved template of the platform number)

segment.notes: All optional and cumulative; empty = every live company. Recipients are the owners (active), one per person (oldest company).

variables.source: STATIC | FIRST_NAME | LAST_NAME | FULL_NAME | COMPANY_NAME (Bref firstName / lastName / fullName / shopName / static)

endpoints.response: 50 newest first: [{id, name, description, status, statusLabel, channels, channelLabels, title, message, segment, whatsapp, scheduledAt, startedAt, sentAt, targetedCount, stats:[{channel, channelLabel, targeted, sent, delivered, read, failed, skipped, uncertain}], history:[], createdAt, updatedAt}]

endpoints.notes: Counted in one query. WHATSAPP / SMS = owners with a usable phone (8–15 digits), EMAIL = with an email; numbers that answered STOP are skipped at send time (stats « skipped »).

endpoints.response: campaign with stats and history [{action, actionLabel (Créée, Modifiée, Programmée, Envoi lancé, Annulée, Envoi terminé, Supprimée), actorName (name, « Super-administrateur » or « Système »), detail, at}]

endpoints.request: fields present change; scheduledAt null unschedules

errors: 503 PLATFORM_WHATSAPP_UNAVAILABLE (WhatsApp chosen, platform number not configured)

endpoints.response: same shape as GET /api/v1/whatsapp/conversations, platform number
same shape as the company inbox

endpoints.request: multipart file: JPEG / PNG ≤ 5 MB, MP4 / PDF ≤ 10 MB

stopStart: An owner (or anyone) who writes STOP to the platform number is skipped by platform WhatsApp campaigns until he writes START (other channels unchanged).
notes: A scheduled campaign that cannot leave when due (message / template missing, nobody, too many) goes back to « Brouillon » (history « Modifiée » by « Système ») instead of being retried; a header media id expires after 30 days at Meta, so a campaign scheduled further out must use a link.
